title: Launcher full run on the Mac: terminal results saved passed/exit 0, but the outer process exited 1 nine milliseconds later with its output lost
outcome: Launcher full run on the Mac: terminal results saved passed/exit 0, but the outer process exited 1 nine milliseconds later with its output lost
acceptance: The path that set exit code 1 after a saved passed terminal result is identified with evidence. Candidates in scripts/test-launcher.mjs: the catch at :1933 (a runner error after the terminal result was saved), summarize() throwing into main().catch at :2179-2182, a stdout write failure such as EPIPE, or notifyRun at :1970-1976
The launcher records the cause durably in the run directory, so the reason for a non-zero outer exit is recoverable without the original stdout or stderr; a test covers the identified path
